ideas.pitch: A command-line tool built in Python to statically detect edge-case logic errors, memory leaks, and syntax bugs in C, C++, Java, and Python code snippets without requiring execution.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 – Debugging Challenge (Elimination Round): Participants will be given 5 buggy code snippets. Identify the errors and suggest appropriate corrections.
ideas.title: BugScope CLI: Static Code Bug Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the exact format of Round 1 where code execution is forbidden, giving individual contestants an edge in spotting hidden syntax traps and logical edge cases fast.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight local debugging assistant tailored for competitive programmers to step through multi-variable states in C and Python code blocks during timed contests.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2 – Final Coding Contest: Qualified participants will solve 3 coding problems of varying difficulty under a strict time limit.
ideas.title: SyntaxTrace: Offline Algorithm Visualizer & Debugger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on speed and readability, which are explicitly stated evaluation criteria alongside correctness and efficiency in the final coding contest.

ideas.pitch: An automated refactoring tool that enforces clean coding practices, naming conventions, and optimal time-complexity patterns for Python and C++ submissions.
ideas.problem_statement: Solutions will be evaluated on correctness, efficiency, readability, and coding practices.
ideas.title: CodeRefiner: Clean Code & Readability Linter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific evaluation criteria of 'readability and coding practices' which human evaluators often dock points for during manual code grading.

ideas.pitch: A benchmarking harness that automatically wraps C, C++, and Python solutions to measure execution time against large input bounds, preventing TLE errors in Round 2.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2 – Final Coding Contest: Qualified participants will solve 3 coding problems of varying difficulty. At least 2 problems must be solved to qualify for ranking.
ideas.title: AlgoBench: Time-Complexity Stress Tester
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets efficiency constraints directly by letting individual competitors verify if their code meets optimal complexity bounds before final submission.

ideas.pitch: An offline desktop snippet manager for C, C++, Java, and Python boilerplate structures designed for rapid code assembly during time-constrained coding rounds.
ideas.title: SnippetVault: Multi-Language Competitive Programming Template Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Built for individual participants facing intense 2-hour limits who need instantaneous access to optimal templates for data structures and algorithms.
